name: graveyard-watch
description: Watches GitHub repositories for dead npm dependencies, shows them as a graveyard, reports who newly died each night, and lets the necromancer agent resurrect them with curated, tested recipes. Powered by Revenant.
author: RamSuryaCH
highlights: Graveyard page: every watched repo as tombstones, with the cited API field behind each cause of death
Nightly rescan that names the packages that died since last night
Necromancer agent resurrects moment, request and uuid@3 through the Revenant MCP tools, with differential tests
Resets the Revenant demo repo (RamSuryaCH/revenant-crypt) every night, and only that repo

crons.name: nightly-rescan
crons.message: Rescan watched repositories, report newly dead dependencies, reset the Revenant demo repo

useCases: Know the morning after which of your dependencies were declared dead, then resurrect them.
configuration: Set GITHUB_TOKEN in the gateway environment to raise GitHub limits. Set REVENANT_CRYPT_DIR to your local clone of RamSuryaCH/revenant-crypt for the nightly reset. The nightly reset is a dry run unless REVENANT_RESET_LIVE=1 is set in the gateway environment, because a live reset closes the demo pull requests.
